architecture: frozen DURA and Tri-SIG-TIME SSL; sample-dependent attenuation of 12 singular components of period-20 residual; 16 trailing samples preserved
train_signal: paired clean source waveform aligned to DURA within ±16; frozen teacher features and soft probabilities from original unaligned clean waveform
training_loss: normalized IQ MSE + 0.1 cosine feature loss + 0.1 KL distillation + 0.02 shrinkage penalty
fixed_gate: existing blind noise proxy <10dB and normalized input/output difference >0.2
caveat: Source simulator SNR and labels are not inference inputs; teacher and DURA saw source records; source IDs may overlap earlier diagnostics. ±64 IQ alignment used for selected holdout quality.
